name: inertia
description: A calm local workspace for coding with agents.
author: Eduard Tomas Velez

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && npm run build:private-connect && npm run check:renderer-bundle
scripts.build:bundle: electron-vite build && npm run build:private-connect && npm run check:renderer-bundle
scripts.check:node-runtime: npm run typecheck && npm run prestatus:runtime && node scripts/check-node-runtime-compatibility.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:standard && npm run lint:type-aware
scripts.lint:type-aware: oxlint src scripts tests benchmarks --type-aware -A all -D typescript/no-floating-promises -D typescript/no-misused-promises -D typescript/await-thenable --deny-warnings
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && npm run typecheck:private-connect && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.unit.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.e2e.json
scripts.test:duo: npm run test:duo:server && vitest run tests/renderer/multi-spawn tests/renderer/duo
scripts.test:portable: vitest run --maxWorkers=1 tests/main/runtime-process-protocol.test.ts tests/main/runtime-supervisor.test.ts tests/main/runtime-supervisor-lifecycle.test.ts tests/server/process-lifecycle.test.ts tests/server/providers.test.ts tests/server/provider-metadata.test.ts tests/server/provider-io.test.ts tests/server/agent-harness.test.ts tests/server/acp-json-rpc.test.ts tests/server/acp-compaction-projection.test.ts tests/server/turn-controller-truthfulness.test.ts tests/server/provider-compaction.test.ts tests/server/provider-host-tool-injection.test.ts tests/server/codex-app-server.test.ts tests/server/codex-jsonl-writer.test.ts tests/server/codex-subagent-lifecycle.test.ts tests/server/codex-fast-mode.test.ts tests/server/claude-agent-sdk-harness.test.ts tests/server/claude-agent-sdk-lifecycle.test.ts tests/server/claude-sdk-message-projection.test.ts tests/server/claude-fast-mode.test.ts tests/server/claude-large-event.test.ts tests/server/cursor-acp-harness.test.ts tests/server/kimi-acp-harness.test.ts tests/server/native-kimi-provider-migration.test.ts tests/server/opencode-descendant-interactions.test.ts tests/server/opencode-sdk-harness.test.ts tests/server/opencode-boundary.test.ts
scripts.check:quality: npm run check:migrations && npm run check:architecture && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.check:platform: npm run check:quality && npm run check:private-connect && npm run build:bundle
scripts.check: npm run check:quality && npm run test && npm run check:private-connect && npm run build:bundle
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:release:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.release.cjs --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:release:mac:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.release.cjs --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:release:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.release.cjs --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:release:win:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.release.cjs --win --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:release:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.release.cjs --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:release:linux:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.release.cjs --linux AppImage --arm64 --publish never

entry.Name: Inertia
entry.Comment: A calm local workspace for coding with agents.
